verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Conductor running many agents in parallel, each in its own workspace. It also documents an API and MCP server for managing cloud workspaces programmatically. None of this documents a bulk operation, such as multi-selecting workspaces to archive, merge, reassign or prompt them all at once. Parallel execution is an adjacent capability, and the API is only a developer building block someone could script bulk actions with, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
